title: Salary sacrifice reform for pension contributions from 6 April 2029

sources.name: HMRC policy paper: Salary sacrifice reform for pension contributions effective from 6 April 2029
sources.note: Announced at Budget 2025. Primary legislation is to be introduced; the design and operation of the limit is to be set out in secondary legislation.

contributionLimit.note: Salary or bonuses sacrificed for employer pension contributions above this limit in a tax year become earnings for Class 1 National Insurance, employee and employer. Income tax relief is unchanged.

statedImpacts.note: HMRC's own estimates in the policy paper's summary of impacts; the latest forgone figure is for the most recent year the paper gives.
